outcome: Positive correlations between maternal urinary iodine and maternal breastmilk iodine
Positive correlation between maternal urinary iodine and neonatal urinary iodine
Positive correlation between maternal breastmilk iodine and neonatal urinary iodine
cohort: The study included 57 pregnant women in their third trimester and their breastfed neonates within the first 28 days of birth.
finding: Significant positive correlations were found between maternal urinary iodine and breastmilk iodine, maternal urinary iodine and neonatal urinary iodine, and breastmilk iodine and neonatal urinary iodine.
cross-section timing: Maternal urine samples were collected in the third trimester, maternal breast milk samples after childbirth, and neonatal urine samples within the first 28 days of birth.
